mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as expansionary monetary policy reduces discount rates and increases equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2.0, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 250 (CPIAUCSL > 250) signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and reducing equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 250, or the rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 2.0%, it signals a weakening economy and potential monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 1200 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), persistent wage pressures drive inflation, leading to aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0, or the rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200 thousand units, it signals robust economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1200, or the rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong industrial production index (INDPRO > 105) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO > 105, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 500,000 million dollars, it signals strong consumer spending and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS > 500000, or the rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 149,000 thousand persons and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 2.0%, it signals a strong labor market and accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS > 149000 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
